The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e3e66a407773ad5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. statement: Let K be an algebraically closed field and A/K an abelian variety of dimension g. For every prime ℓ ̸= char(K), numerical and ℓ-adic homological equivalence coincide on rational algebraic cycles on A. For every rational ample divisor class h and every integer 0 ≤ r ≤ g/2, the rational symmetric form Pr h(A) × Pr h(A) −→ Q, (x, y) 7−→ (−1)r deg(xy hg−2r ) is positive definite after extension of scalars to R. Thus the Hodge standard conjecture for ℓ-adic étale cohomology holds for abelian varieties in arbitrary characteristic.
